html:
Build a singly linked list from values, reverse its next pointers iteratively, and return the reversed values as a list.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      2,
      5,
      9
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    9,
    5,
    2
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Save the next pointer before redirecting it.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(n) nodes and returned output
